svg.title: Figure 8. The recurring improvement loop
svg.desc: Eight stages arranged as a closed loop: 1 evidence from use, 2 pattern analysis and intake, 3 diagnosis, 4 synthetic investigation, 5 candidate change, 6 evaluation, 7 approval and release, 8 post-release evidence, returning to 1. Fill style shows which stages the platform can perform under human oversight, which it proposes or drafts for a person to confirm or edit, and which require human approval. Side notes: retained tests protect future versions; automation grows with evidence — the platform proposes, people approve.
svg.text: Evidence from use becomes a scoped, tested, approved change — and new evidence about that change.
scoped to the tier that owns
platform proposes or drafts; a person confirms or edits (stages 3, 5)
Reference design; identifiers are illustrative (fictional Wrenfield University).
